tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background and the arena. Text on it: ink, muted, accent.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Top bar, side panels, stage cards, sheets. Text on it: ink, muted, accent.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, segmented controls, cards sitting on bg or panel. Text on it: ink, muted.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines, grid dots, track of a progress bar. Never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders, beams, unselected node outlines, empty-slot outlines. At least 3:1 on bg, panel and panel-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, node outlines, readout values on bg, panel and panel-raised.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels, units, captions, disabled explanations on bg, panel and panel-raised (4.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one signal colour: primary action, live signal, firing neurons, motor arcs, cores, focus ring, progress fill. Reads on bg, panel and panel-raised.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Outline of the frame, top bar, side panels and cards: a cyan-tinted hairline in neon, a neutral warm grey in paper. Decorative; controls use line-strong.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected-tool and current-cell wash behind ink text. Decorative; the state also needs a border or label.

tokens.name: accent-glow
tokens.usage: Glow halo behind firing nodes. Decorative and removable; transparent in the paper theme.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills.

tokens.name: halo
tokens.usage: Selection and focus of a thing the player tapped: ring around a part, outline of a selected stage. Static, never pulses. Always with a name label.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Invalid anatomy and destructive actions, always with a warn icon and a plain sentence. Reads on bg and panel.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Glow on primary buttons and active tools. Paper theme and data-effects=lite set it to none.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Screen and panel titles in the top bar and sheets.

styles.name: stage
styles.usage: Signal-flow stage names (SEES, DECIDES, TWISTS, SCORES), upper case.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Explanations and helper lines. 13px is the floor for sentences.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button and tab labels, upper case.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Row labels inside dense stage cards. Only for one to three words.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Live values in stage cards and the brain view.

styles.name: readout-sm
styles.usage: Ticks, cell numbers and axis labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between controls in a row; screen edge inset in landscape.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between panels and cards.

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target in the 640 x 360 design canvas.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips and progress cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and the device frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and unlock chips.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Dividers, grid dots and ruler ticks.

tokens.name: stroke-beam
tokens.usage: Beams in the arena and builder.

tokens.name: stroke-signal
tokens.usage: Motor arcs and the heaviest network edges.
